details.question: Which company has the lowest market share in fiscal year 2024-2025?
details.expected_sql: WITH company_sales AS (SELECT comname, SUM(netweight_tmt) AS company_total FROM industry_performance WHERE (category != 'O' OR category IS NULL) AND fiscal_year = '2024-2025' GROUP BY comname), total_market AS (SELECT SUM(netweight_tmt) AS market_total FROM industry_performance WHERE (category != 'O' OR category IS NULL) AND fiscal_year = '2024-2025') SELECT cs.comname, ROUND((cs.company_total * 100.0) / tm.market_total, 2) AS market_share_percentage FROM company_sales cs CROSS JOIN total_market tm ORDER BY market_share_percentage ASC LIMIT 1;
details.generated_sql:
WITH company_sales AS (
    SELECT industry_performance.comname, SUM(industry_performance.netweight_tmt) AS company_total
    FROM industry_performance
    WHERE (industry_performance.category != 'O' OR industry_performance.category IS NULL) AND industry_performance.fiscal_year = '2024-2025'
    GROUP BY industry_performance.comname
),
total_market AS (
    SELECT SUM(industry_performance.netweight_tmt) AS market_total
    FROM industry_performance
    WHERE (industry_performance.category != 'O' OR industry_performance.category IS NULL) AND industry_performance.fiscal_year = '2024-2025'
)
SELECT company_sales.comname,
       ROUND((company_sales.company_total * 100.0) / NULLIF(total_market.market_total, 0), 2) AS market_share_percentage
FROM company_sales
CROSS JOIN total_market
ORDER BY market_share_percentage ASC
LIMIT 1;

details.question: Show the industry performance total sales in TMT for IOCL for the strategic business unit I&C in the current fiscal year.
details.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(netweight_tmt)::numeric, 2) AS total_sales_tmt FROM industry_performance WHERE (category != 'O' OR category IS NULL) AND comname = 'IOCL' AND sbu_name = 'I&C' AND fiscal_year = (CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NOW()) >= 4 THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::text || '-' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW()) + 1)::text ELSE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW()) - 1)::text || '-' || EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::text END);
